domain: the vicfei dsh plugin family: multi-agent investment committees, quant research plugins, semantic layers, ontology construction for DeepSeek Harness

entity_types.name: agent_persona
entity_types.desc: A named investor or analyst persona (e.g. Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Wood) that produces an independent valuation or verdict.

entity_types.name: diary_entry
entity_types.desc: An append-only record written per settled turn into a user-owned git repository.

entity_types.name: dsh_plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin in the vicfei dsh family, packaged as a repository with a README and installable into DSH.

entity_types.name: evidence_tag
entity_types.desc: A source quote or citation attached to an assertion, claim, or ontology element to ground it.

entity_types.name: exchange
entity_types.desc: A crypto trading venue accessed through the CCXT bridge.

entity_types.name: ic_memo
entity_types.desc: An auditable investment-committee memo recording verdicts, named drivers, dissent, and evidence tags.

entity_types.name: investment_committee
entity_types.desc: A multi-agent committee that aggregates independent persona verdicts into a single decision memo.

entity_types.name: market_data_payload
entity_types.desc: A read-only market data record returned by an exchange bridge, tagged with exchange and timestamp.

entity_types.name: ontology
entity_types.desc: A typed knowledge structure consisting of a TBox schema and ABox instances, produced by ontology construction.

entity_types.name: ontology_entity
entity_types.desc: A typed entity instance in an ontology's ABox, carrying its source evidence.

entity_types.name: ontology_relation
entity_types.desc: A typed relation between ontology entities, carrying its source evidence.

entity_types.name: ontology_type
entity_types.desc: A schema-level class or relation type in the TBox, possibly flagged as unknown or conflicting.

entity_types.name: session_event
entity_types.desc: A durable event on the harness session/event stream (e.g. turn/end, session/disposed) that plugins subscribe to.

entity_types.name: trading_guard
entity_types.desc: A fail-closed code-level safeguard (unlock arming, notional caps, symbol whitelist) that constrains order placement.

entity_types.name: turn
entity_types.desc: A unit of agent execution that settles with a reason such as completed, error, max-tokens, or aborted.

relation_types.name: has_persona
relation_types.desc: A committee is composed of independent investor personas that each value the target.

relation_types.name: produces_memo
relation_types.desc: A committee emits an auditable IC-MEMO as its output.

relation_types.name: records_dissent
relation_types.desc: A memo names unrebutted objections raised by a persona, preserving dissent.

relation_types.name: supports_claim
relation_types.desc: An evidence tag grounds a claim or verdict recorded in a memo.

relation_types.name: contains_entity
relation_types.desc: An ontology holds typed entity instances in its ABox.

relation_types.name: contains_relation
relation_types.desc: An ontology holds typed relations between entities.

relation_types.name: has_type
relation_types.desc: An entity instance is assigned a schema type from the TBox.

relation_types.name: grounded_by
relation_types.desc: An entity assertion is backed by its source quote; ungrounded ones are flagged.

relation_types.name: relation_grounded_by
relation_types.desc: A relation assertion is backed by its source quote.

relation_types.name: subscribes_to
relation_types.desc: A plugin listens to the durable session/event stream.

relation_types.name: writes_entry
relation_types.desc: The diary plugin appends a diary entry per settled turn.

relation_types.name: settles_as
relation_types.desc: A turn settles when the harness emits turn/end with a terminal reason.

relation_types.name: guards_orders
relation_types.desc: A trading guard constrains order placement against an exchange.

relation_types.name: returns_payload
relation_types.desc: An exchange bridge returns market data payloads tagged with exchange and timestamp.

relation_types.name: sibling_of
relation_types.desc: A plugin is a sibling or sister project of another plugin in the family.
